thread:
zack: quick heads-up 1: small audit found ~22 pages still using v1 model aliases and an old SDK param name that breaks the v2 client. We should triage before the deprecation banner goes up.

anika: can you paste the audit?

zack: uploaded CSV to the tracking issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4477 (columns: path, type, suggested_action)

samir: typical hits? examples, quickstarts, and the public migration guide?

zack: mostly examples (9), two quickstarts, three customer guides, and some references in generated API pages. SDK snippets: node & python have `include_metadata` -> v2 expects `meta`.

elaine: priority order: 1) customer guides 2) quickstarts 3) examples 4) API reference. Customer guides get redirects only if they are heavily linked externally. Otherwise, update in place + note.

jordan: I'll add a docs-ci lint to fail on `include_metadata` usage in code blocks. Add to #643 so authors get immediate feedback.

docs-bot: running site link-check + snippet-lint. Results: broken param usage found in 11 snippets, 4 external inbound links to /api/v1/* endpoints. Full run: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/link-scan-1746554321.html

samir: I'll take the examples and quickstarts. Planning PRs: #683 (python quickstart fix), #684 (node streaming shim note), #685 (embeddings example update).

anika: ops-bot, can infra accept a small 301 redirect map for the four externally-linked old API pages? We want to avoid immediate content churn for externally-referenced pages.

ops-bot: yes. Please add entries to infra/redirects/pending-1746554321.csv in the infra repo. Ops can roll config in the next deploy window (ETA 20m once PR merged).

elaine: I'll compile the CSV. Add reason column: "external backlink" or "internal snippet". Also add owner column.

zack: note on SDK behavior: v2 will error if unknown param is passed. For language samples that's a hard fail. For embeddings the old `include_metadata` used to be ignored. Need to test behavior in sample runner.

jordan: smoke test plan: (a) render page, (b) exec fenced code block via snippet runner, (c) detect runtime error. I'll add checks to docs-ci job `snippet-smoke` as part of #643.

anika: communication plan: publish a short deprecation banner tomorrow (48h notice) and a one-paragraph migration checklist in /guides/migration/quick-migration.md. Keep it terse: param rename table, model alias table, where redirects are in place.

samir: can we produce a small compatibility shim in the SDKs that logs a warning for `include_metadata` -> `meta` to ease transition? Might reduce docs churn.

jordan: ops prefers code-level fixes for samples because shims delay correct usage. But a short-term shim in patch release could reduce customer breakage while docs updates roll out.

ops-bot: release note: patch with logging shim would be a minor release; coordinate with platform to avoid thrashing model routing. Schedule window: tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC possible.

elaine: CSV uploaded at infra/redirects/pending-1746554321.csv (12 entries). Owners: samir (examples), mike (api ref), anika (guides).

zack: added a quick grep for model aliases in guides: hits in /guides/deployments/ plus /guides/migration/alias-handling.md. Those will need explicit replacement suggestions and a note on fallback semantics.

anika: mike will update alias-handling.md with an alias mapping table and compatibility guidance. Mike, please include the exact new model ids and recommended snippets.

mike: on it. PR #686 created.

samir: PRs for examples up: #683,#684,#685. Each contains a test commit that runs the snippet in CI. Hoping for fast review.

jordan: merged #643 (snippet lint). Docs CI will now fail on param matches and old /v1 links in markdown. Please fix any failures quickly.

anika: final checklist before banner: 1) redirects deployed for external pages, 2) examples PRs merged and smoke tests pass, 3) migration quick doc published, 4) SDK shim decision made. Who owns sign-off?

elaine: I'll sign off on docs and redirects once CSV is applied and smoke jobs are green. Ops will sign-off on redirects post-deploy. SDK team to decide shim by EOD.

zack: thanks. I'll monitor tracking issue #4477 and ping if anything new shows up.

ops-bot: redirect config deployed at 1746555600 1: sample mapping: `/api/old/stream` -> `/api/v2/stream` (301). Post-deploy smoke: passes 3/3 checks.

anika: banner live in staging. Let's run a quick production smoke after ops rollout. jordan, can you schedule a post-deploy job?

jordan: scheduled. post-deploy checks: 1) attempt old external URL -> 301, 2) run python quickstart snippet -> exits 0, 3) alias resolution returns new id.

zack: one last thing: add a short FAQ entry on "why did my snippet break" referencing param rename and linking to migration quick doc. I'll open #687.

samir: thanks all, will watch CI & merge. :raised_hands:
